meta.note: Values are a glass redesign of the source variables; names and component families follow the source. Source values are listed in migration.md.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every glass surface. Paint the ambient tints over it so the blur has something to show.

tokens.name: bg-tint-violet
tokens.usage: Ambient blob behind the page, upper left. Only ever blurred under glass, never as a fill for UI.

tokens.name: bg-tint-teal
tokens.usage: Ambient blob behind the page, lower right. Only ever blurred under glass.

tokens.name: bg-tint-rose
tokens.usage: Third ambient blob, small, centre right. Only ever blurred under glass.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default glass fill for panels, job cards and the top bar. Always paired with blur-glass and glass-border. Was --surface.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for dialogs and anything that holds a form over busy content. Pairs with blur-dialog.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Inner glass for inputs, track cards and lyric options nested inside a panel. Was --surface-2.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge on every glass surface. Reads as a light catch, not a line.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside glass (panel heads, row controls, advanced sections). Was --border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of inputs, selects, ghost buttons and the switch track. 3:1 against glass in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on glass, glass-strong and glass-inset. Was --text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on glass, glass-strong and glass-inset: hints, meta, placeholders, tags. 4.5:1 or better on every glass. Was --muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary button fill, focus ring, active switch, progress bar, link buttons. Was --accent (#6d5dfc).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Dark theme lightens the accent, so its ink goes dark. Was --accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted glass for the Generating badge, focus halo and cover-art placeholder. Was --accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Ready badge text and the healthy credits dot. Text use passes 4.5:1 on glass. Was --ok.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ready badge fill behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Low-credits dot and any warning text. Was --warn.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed badge text, error alert text, failed credits dot. Was --danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and Failed badge fill behind danger text. Was --danger-soft.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop, combined with blur-scrim.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch thumb in both themes.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most. The cover and any future landing hero.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Panel h1 (composer heading). Was h1 at 1.35rem.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Panel h2 and dialog h3. Was h2 at 1.1rem.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Job titles, track titles, lyric option titles. Was h3 and .track-title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Suno writes the lyrics and structure for you.
styles.usage: Default copy, input values, dialog paragraphs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Switch labels, primary and ghost button text, segmented control.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, link buttons, status pill, segment text. Was .85rem 600.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, job meta, button notes, track tags. Always in muted. Was .78rem.

styles.name: lyrics
styles.sample:
[Verse]
Tail lights fade along the river bend
styles.usage: Lyric sheets and lyric options, white-space preserved.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Character counts, slider outputs, credit balance. Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding, switch thumb inset, progress margins.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls: pill, top bar actions, field label to input, track actions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, track card padding, lyric option padding, job head gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Job card padding, panel head bottom margin, section gaps, phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top bar horizontal padding, layout gap and padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel and dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the composer and the library on wide screens; dialog top margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty state vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, icon buttons, segments, lyric sheets, cover art. Was 8 to 10px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, track cards, alerts, lyric options, the brand mark. Was 12px.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and job cards. Was --radius 14px.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pill, badges, switch track, progress bar.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every panel, job card and the top bar. The inset line is the glass catch light. Was --shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs and anything lifted above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Active segment, switch thumb, primary button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring halo on inputs, switch and buttons, outside a 1px accent border.

blur.note: backdrop-filter values. Always ship a solid fallback: @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) swaps glass for glass-strong.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Panels, job cards, top bar.

tokens.name: blur-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop over the page.

tokens.name: blur-ambient
tokens.usage: The three bg-tint blobs behind the page.

timing.note: Durations and easings. Honour prefers-reduced-motion: set every duration to 0 and stop the indeterminate bar.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills, press scale, segment switch.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Focus ring, switch thumb, border colour.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Progress bar width changes.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition that moves or resizes.
